Please provide only the correct answer in its simplest form, without any additional text or explanation.

The college counselor had two more appointments for the day - a Korean student and a Senegalese student. One was struggling in class because they were pressurized to change their major by their parents and the other wanted to take a semester off to think about their career. The Korean student was the one who was being forced by their parents while in contrast their parents of the Senegalese student were very open to anything their child wanted to do. Whose parents were open minded about their child's choices?
A. The Korean student
B. Not enough info
C. The Senegalese student
